header.name: Hero Motocorp Ltd
header.source: NSE closing price (end of day, not live); 52-week range computed from daily highs and lows (NSE bhavcopy)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Hero Motocorp (NSE: HEROMOTOCO) makes and sells motorcycles and scooters; its consolidated revenue in FY26 was ₹47,411 crore.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: In the quarter to 30 Sep 2026, revenue was ₹14,970 crore, 22.5% more than a year earlier; the operating margin was 11.8% against 13.5%, and profit attributable to shareholders was ₹1,861 crore, 42.2% higher.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: On 29 Oct 2026, the first session after the result, HEROMOTOCO shares fell 4.09% while the NIFTY 50 rose 1.05% and the NIFTY AUTO index fell 0.24%; allowing for the market's move, HEROMOTOCO's own move was -5.38%, about 4.02 times its usual daily variation.

claims.label: UNCERTAIN
claims.text: These numbers measure the move, not its cause: the result, the autos sector's fall and any other news that day overlap, and nothing here separates them.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: At ₹5,535 (NSE close, 23 Nov 2026), a discounted cash flow model with a 12.48% cost of capital matches the price if revenue grows about 12.2% a year for five years at the FY26 operating margin of 13.1%; HEROMOTOCO's revenue grew 11.5% a year over FY23–FY26.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: With the other assumptions at base, the valuation is most sensitive to the operating margin (two percentage points either way: a model value of ₹4,745 to ₹6,042 a share) and to the cost of capital (one percentage point either way: a model value of ₹4,842 to ₹6,118 a share); the Q3 FY27 result will be the next reported quarter.

prices.note: Each series is rebased to 100 on the first common session. Raw exchange prices are not published here (NSE terms).

metrics.label: Market cap
metrics.definition: Price × shares outstanding (share capital ÷ ₹2 face value at 2026-09-30).

metrics.label: P/E (TTM)
metrics.definition: Price ÷ earnings per share over the last four reported quarters (Q3 FY26 – Q2 FY27).

metrics.label: EV / EBIT (TTM)
metrics.definition: Enterprise value (market cap − the net cash and treasury figure below) ÷ operating profit over the last four quarters.

metrics.label: Net cash and treasury
metrics.definition: Cash, bank balances and treasury investments, plus investments in joint ventures and associates, less lease liabilities, borrowings, preference shares and minority interests, at 30 Sep 2026.

metrics.label: Operating margin (FY26)
metrics.definition: EBIT ÷ revenue, after depreciation, excluding other income. Sites that quote an EBITDA-based margin show a higher figure.

metrics.label: ROE (FY26)
metrics.definition: Profit for the year ÷ total equity at year end.

metrics.label: ROIC (FY26)
metrics.definition: After-tax EBIT ÷ invested capital at the start of the year. Invested capital excludes about ₹12k crore of cash and treasury, which is why it looks so high.

metrics.label: Revenue growth FY23–FY26
metrics.definition: Compound annual growth of revenue from FY23 to FY26.

metrics.label: Cash conversion (FY26)
metrics.definition: Operating cash flow ÷ profit for the year.

metrics.label: Beta vs NIFTY 50
metrics.definition: Sensitivity of HEROMOTOCO's daily return to the NIFTY 50's, over the two years to the price date.

flags.title: The exchange's files contain errors
flags.text: 2 reconciliation checks fail on the exchange's own files, each with a recorded reason. They are marked as explained, not passed, and the figure as filed is used, never a corrected one.

flags.title: Associates are not consolidated line by line
flags.text: Hero MotoCorp's associates, including its finance affiliate, are accounted for under the equity method, so their profit enters as a share of profit and their assets as an investment.

limitations: Template A (non-financial, positive free cash flow). Single-stage fade model; no currency driver.
Cash flows are discounted to the balance-sheet date, 30 Sep 2026, two months before the price date; the model does not roll that gap forward, so its values are slightly low against the price.
Debt is borrowings plus lease liabilities; earmarked bank balances are counted as cash, which overstates cash slightly.
The risk-free rate is a twelve-month average while the price and equity risk premium are point-in-time.
The event study measures the size of a move, not its cause; five results days are too few for statistical claims.

Hero MotoCorp's associates (including its finance affiliate) are accounted for under the equity method, so their profit enters as a share of profit and their assets as an investment, not line by line.

Hero's XBRL for the year to March 2022 files the other comprehensive income under 'total comprehensive income attributable to owners'; the check on that split is shown as explained, and the item is not used.

From FY23 the figures come from the exchange XBRL filings; the owners' share of FY23 profit and the lease liabilities for FY23 to FY25 come from the results PDFs (text layers checked against the printed subtotals and the XBRL).
Static page: prices are end-of-day as of the date shown, not live.
